blocks.text: Screenshots: actual patched Ink 0.19 browser diagnostics. Videos are edited screenshot walkthroughs. Neither is Studio or glasses footage.
Two repositories, two roles. The Starter Kit contains editable AIUI apps. Your Rokid AIUI Agent DevKit Skill guides the coding assistant. Install the Skill once, then use it to modify either demo.
Before you begin

Bring a laptop, a coding tool with Agent Skills, Node.js 22.20+, Python 3 and Git. Printed commands use a macOS/Linux shell; prepare an equivalent Windows environment before class. Studio use also requires access to AIUI Studio.
Scan or click for source, multilingual READMEs and demo videos. Suggested hands-on loop: 5 min run, 15 min edit, 5 min check, 5 min show.

pages.title: Get to a visible baseline
pages.subtitle: Use the repository root for terminal commands. Start with a no-key flow.

blocks.text: 1. Get the project and install its tools
2. Install and load your DevKit
Open this folder in your coding tool. The list should show rokid-aiui-agent. For Claude Code, replace codex with claude-code in both commands; for Cursor, use cursor.

In coding chat: invoke $rokid-aiui-agent in Codex, or /rokid-aiui-agent in Claude Code. In Cursor, select the Skill from /. Ask the assistant to read the project instructions and report its loaded SKILL.md path.
3. Open the diagnostic browser walkthrough

127.0.0.1:8768/cook-along-diagnostic.html
127.0.0.1:8768/style-lens-diagnostic.html
Keep the server terminal open; Ctrl+C stops it. The first generation needs internet to download the pinned runtime. After an edit, regenerate that demo and reload.
Using AIUI Studio?

Import only the folder containing app.json; open the Page in _blank.
Cook: demos/cook-along/app / Page pages/index
Style: demos/style-lens/app / Page pages/index/index

Preview status: unmodified Ink 0.19 preview currently fails at startup. The diagnostic helper patches a separate local preview runtime. It supports layout/click practice; Studio and physical-glasses checks remain separate.

blocks.text: Copy this first exercise into your coding chat

lines: Read this project's AGENTS.md and continuity files, then load the
installed Skill and report its path. In demos/cook-along/app, adapt
the coffee preset into a short tea-brewing guide. Keep the existing
recipe IDs, AIUI 0.19.0, English UI, step navigation and timer behavior.
Update the runtime guidance to match. Keep all app dependencies
inside its app directory. Run npm run verify; report changed files
and actual results. Keep untested Studio and glasses checks BLOCKED.

blocks.text: See your change: regenerate the chosen browser diagnostic, then reload it. In Studio, reimport your edited local app directory. For GitHub import, first push to your own repo/ref. Importing public BreezeLife/main again loads the original starter.

Your 30-second share-back: show the starting flow, one visible change, and the verification result. Each demo README contains three more copyable prompts. For Style Lens Live behavior, the model prompt is in server/prompt.mjs.

pages.title: Check your change. Then go Live.
pages.subtitle: Sample mode is enough for the workshop. Live is an optional extension.

blocks.text: 1. Verify from the Starter Kit root

verify runs tests, strict AIUI 0.19 checks and capability inventory. pack also requires Bash and writes archives to output/packages/. Local results: output/verification/local-results.json. Baseline: 38 passing tests; this does not certify Studio or glasses.
2. Optional: connect Style Lens to a vision provider
Keep Sample until your backend is ready. From the Starter Kit root, prepare the separate Node.js proxy:

lines: # Fill the private .env before starting (see below).

blocks.text: Set <font name="Courier">VISION_API_KEY</font>, <font name="Courier">VISION_MODEL</font>, <font name="Courier">TEAM_TOKEN</font> and <font name="Courier">TEAM_TOKEN_EXPIRES_AT</font>. The team token is 32-128 base64url characters; expiry must be within the next 24 hours. Generate fresh credentials near the session. Keep the provider key on the server.

Deploy behind reachable HTTPS; a laptop localhost URL is not a glasses endpoint. Follow the backend guide for token generation, health checks and Docker/Compose setup. Then edit these fields in your private demos/style-lens/app/config.js:

Verify from the root and reimport the edited app. Choose Try Live, then Capture & send, grant camera permission and confirm the system preview. This sends the photo to your configured provider and may incur charges. Keep the configured app private; Use Sample is the fallback.
If you get stuck

Skill missing: reload the tool; set AIUI_SKILL_DIR to the resolved Skill folder if needed.
Old UI still showing: regenerate the preview or check the imported local folder/repo/ref.
Live setup / 401: check the HTTPS endpoint, matching team token and fresh expiry.

Presenter preflight: run both no-key flows on the teaching laptop before the session; keep the two 30-second videos available. Studio, glasses, real camera/provider and Docker execution remain unverified in this starter. Use Sample unless you have tested your own Live setup.
